note: Per-file ceiling of whole-document lookups outside the sanctioned cached accessors (packages/engine/src/host-seats.ts, bus.ts, stylesheet.ts, chat-dom.ts). Queries by id are uncounted; counts only shrink.

packages/client/src/features/permissions.reason: The teardown sweeps the segment groups and the tier card's nodes in one call.

packages/client/src/features/model/model.reason: The two cards' instance-scoped sweep during refresh and when they are dropped or torn down.

packages/client/src/features/account/acc.reason: The takeover's teardown sweeps the rows it injected and the marks it put on the host's entries.
The self-built trigger and popover, swept when the drawer is dropped.

packages/client/src/features/workspace/v.reason: The menu card a generation whose teardown a client reload dropped left in the body, swept once when the next trigger is seated.

packages/client/src/core/selection-paint.reason: The transcript roots the selection paints were opened on, swept once at teardown: a root keeps its mark until the host replaces it, so no list of them outlives the page that holds them.

packages/client/src/features/composer/co.reason: The marks the composer wrote, swept once at install and once at teardown.

packages/client/src/features/context-sta.reason: The ring a generation whose teardown a client reload dropped left behind in the model slot, swept once when the next generation installs.

packages/client/src/features/chat-fold/p.reason: The process groups, read once at install and again when the shell language changes; the summary marks swept at teardown, both the named headers' and any span written this frame whose measuring pass never ran.

packages/client/src/features/context-sta.reason: The stray context block and panel marks swept once when the statistics are installed; composer cards come from the engine's card registry.
The context statistics' own block and panel marks, swept at teardown.

packages/client/src/features/ban-screen/.reason: The hold screen's own node, swept once when the screen is installed.

packages/client/src/features/chat-fold/p.reason: The process groups already on the page, settled once right after install.

packages/client/src/features/chat-fold/r.reason: The thinking rows already on the page, settled once right after install.

packages/client/src/features/chat-reveal.reason: The streaming containers, scanned when an attribute or structural batch arrives. `data-streaming` is set and removed on a node that stays mounted, which a registry of added nodes cannot follow.
The streaming containers, read once when the reveal engine is installed.

packages/client/src/features/chat-wait/c.reason: The waiting line's own marks, swept at teardown.

packages/client/src/features/effort/effo.reason: The effort popover's instance-scoped node, swept when its card is built and when the control is switched off or torn down.

packages/client/src/features/permissions.reason: The first pass of an install reads the control's nodes a previous generation left in the document (a client reload drops its disposals); later passes work from the nodes the feature holds.
